summary: Authors flashcard study decks — two-sided cards a learner flips, rates as known or needing practice, and re-runs by stack.
in_scope: Flashcard decks of two-sided cards (front prompt / back answer)
Self-assessment while studying — rating each card, and re-running just the cards that did not stick
LaTeX math on either side of a card (e.g. "$x^2$")
Image cards — a side that is a URL renders as an image
An optional deck title and instructions
A light or dark deck, with a toggle for the learner
out_of_scope: Matching games and memory (concentration) card games — L0181 is flashcards only
Scored assessments — quizzes, tests, answer keys, rubrics: use L0180
Spaced repetition scheduling or long-term retention tracking
Dynamic deck generation — the cards are literal in the program
Cards with more than two sides, or more than one answer per prompt
Deck ordering and shuffling policy — the player shuffles, the program does not say how
